[SWS_DM_00897] Usage of ClearDTC Interface
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04194
⌈
If the function
ara::diag::DTCInformation::Clear
is called, the DM shall clear
the DTC or
DTC group
provided in the functions parameter
dtcGroup
. The clear
DTC shall clear the fault memory associated to the instance of the
ara::diag::
DTCInformation
class only.
⌋
